programs.title: A8 - Abenteuer Autobahn
programs.desc: For the fourth time we will have the opportunity to take a closer look at German expressways.The creators of the program take us to the A8 motorway.The 505-kilometer route starts in Perl, passes through Karlsruhe, Stuttgart, Augsburg and Munich, reaching all the way to the border with Austria.This road is one of the most important East-West connections in Central Europe.We will be able to see the work of the police, truck drivers, highway maintenance services, and engineers whose task is to smooth traffic.

programs.title: Dream garage
programs.desc: The garage is not only a shelter for the car, but also a man cave.Every guy dreams of such a place - a refuge where he would keep various items that do not necessarily match the interior design of the apartment.Where he could meet his friends and chat over a beer.Unfortunately, garages are often cluttered and lack space and functional solutions.Architect Krzysztof Miruć will help solve these problems. The creators of the program will show how easy and cheap it is to transform chaotically filled spaces into real atmospheric garages.They will advise you how to create peace and order using simple tricks and will tell you what tricks to use to make the place happy for the owner.

programs.desc: Kamil Jaśkowski and Krzysztof Ruszała continue their journey around Poland following the trail of absurd road solutions.They will go to places where officials spent huge amounts of money on non-functional facilities.

programs.title: Road absurdities
programs.desc: In Warsaw, the presenters will visit a bicycle path that cannot be used, show inconsistencies in vertical and horizontal markings and analyze the original no-entry sign in Piotrków Trybunalski.Kamil Jaśkowski and Krzysiek Ruszała will also show a Krakow lamppost in the middle of the bicycle path and an advertising column covering the exit for ambulances.They will also include a series of traffic bans on an unfinished investment in Knurów, passing lanes at one of the intersections in Łódź and a crooked roundabout in Prussia.Finally, they will check why one of the schools in Tychy can only be reached from one side and what the speed limit is on a street in Sosnowiec marked with two different speed limits.
